overall: The AG found the Granby Select Board violated the Open Meeting Law by discussing and voting to withdraw Article One after it had adjourned its February 4, 2019 meeting. The emergency argument was rejected.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board deliberated outside a properly posted meeting by discussing and voting to withdraw a warrant article after adjourning its February 4 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that the Board deliberated outside of an open meeting in violation of the Open Meeting Law when it discussed Article One after the adjournment of its February 4 meeting.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's requirements.
remedy_passage: We order the Board’s immediate and future compliance with the law’s requirements, and caution that similar future violations could be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
